component: Folders extension API asynchronous event test

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test registers a listener before its mutation and accepts only the InfoTest folder with the requested new-message or unread count. It removes that listener after a match. The checked event producer batches per-folder changed fields and the API bridge delivers them asynchronously, so this wait is narrower than consuming the next event. This is static test/producer evidence, not an observed flake cure.
title: The MV3 folder-info test waits for the target folder and expected state
